title: SIEM asset-grouped detection pack
notes: Generated from the asset-grouped SIEM detection catalog markdown.
Each rule is mapped to one or more asset_groups and published with asset_group.* tags.
Stream-capable catalog rows are compiled into normalized stream expressions with allowlist and source-scope guards.
Batch and sequence-style catalog rows are compiled into guarded SQL templates for the batch correlation runtime.
active_source_ids remain review metadata; runtime activation is driven by compiled expr/sql_template output.
Every active runtime rule must pass synthetic validation before being kept in production.

stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: PVE-001: action in [qmcreate, create VM, UPID task qmcreate] Источники: Proxmox task log/syslog/API audit.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.pvedaemon' or event.provider == 'linux.pveproxy' or event.provider == 'linux.pvestatd' or event.provider == 'linux.proxmox-heartbeat') and (event.original icontains 'qmcreate' or event.original icontains 'create VM' or event.original icontains 'UPID task qmcreate' or event.original icontains 'action' or event.original icontains 'create' or event.original icontains 'UPID' or event.original icontains 'task') and (host.name icontains 'pve' or log_source icontains 'pve') and not tags icontains 'allowlist:')

stream_rules.title: AUTH-001 Успешный SSH-вход root
stream_rules.operator_action: Alert. Указать, что правило работает только если auth.log/sshd/sudo пересылается в SIEM через rsyslog/syslog.
stream_rules.description: AUTH-001: sshd Accepted* AND user=root Источники: auth.log/sshd via rsyslog.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'linux.sshd' and (event.type == 'linux_root_ssh_login' or event.type == 'ssh_login_success') and user.name == 'root' and (not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and source.ip != '192.168.1.102' and source.ip != '10.20.30.122' and source.ip != '0'))

stream_rules.title: AUTH-002 Неуспешный SSH-вход root
stream_rules.operator_action: Alert. Указать, что правило работает только если auth.log/sshd/sudo пересылается в SIEM через rsyslog/syslog.
stream_rules.description: AUTH-002: sshd Failed* AND user=root Источники: auth.log/sshd via rsyslog.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'linux.sshd' and event.type == 'ssh_login_failure' and user.name == 'root' and (not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and source.ip != '192.168.1.102' and source.ip != '10.20.30.122' and source.ip != '0'))

stream_rules.title: AUTH-003 Массовые неуспешные SSH-входы
stream_rules.detection_logic: Failed password count>=10 by src_ip in 5m
stream_rules.operator_action: Alert. Указать, что правило работает только если auth.log/sshd/sudo пересылается в SIEM через rsyslog/syslog.
stream_rules.description: AUTH-003: Failed password count>=10 by src_ip in 5m Источники: auth.log/sshd.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'linux.sshd' and event.type == 'ssh_login_failure' and (not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and source.ip != '192.168.1.102' and source.ip != '10.20.30.122' and source.ip != '0'))

stream_rules.title: AUTH-007 sudo-команда
stream_rules.operator_action: Alert. Указать, что правило работает только если auth.log/sshd/sudo пересылается в SIEM через rsyslog/syslog.
stream_rules.description: AUTH-007: message contains 'sudo:' AND 'COMMAND=' Источники: auth.log/sudo.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'linux.sudo' and event.type == 'sudo_command' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e')

stream_rules.title: AUTH-008 Опасная sudo-команда
stream_rules.operator_action: Alert. Указать, что правило работает только если auth.log/sshd/sudo пересылается в SIEM через rsyslog/syslog.
stream_rules.description: AUTH-008: sudo COMMAND contains [useradd,usermod,passwd,visudo,systemctl stop,systemctl disable,iptables,nft,ufw,curl,wget,nc,socat] Источники: auth.log/sudo.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.sudo' or event.provider == 'linux.auditd') and (event.type == 'sudo_command' or event.type == 'sudo_event') and (event.original icontains 'useradd' or event.original icontains 'usermod' or event.original icontains 'passwd' or event.original icontains 'visudo' or event.original icontains 'systemctl stop' or event.original icontains 'systemctl disable' or event.original icontains 'iptables' or event.original icontains 'nft') and (not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and source.ip != '192.168.1.102' and source.ip != '10.20.30.122' and source.ip != '0'))

stream_rules.title: AUTH-009 Пользователь добавлен в sudo/wheel/adm
stream_rules.operator_action: Alert. Указать, что правило работает только если auth.log/sshd/sudo пересылается в SIEM через rsyslog/syslog.
stream_rules.description: AUTH-009: message contains [usermod,adduser] AND group in [sudo,wheel,adm] Источники: auth.log, usermod logs.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.sudo' or event.provider == 'linux.auditd') and (event.type == 'sudo_command' or event.type == 'sudo_event') and (event.original icontains 'usermod' or event.original icontains 'adduser' or event.original icontains 'wheel' or event.original icontains 'adm' or event.original icontains 'group') and (not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and source.ip != '192.168.1.102' and source.ip != '10.20.30.122' and source.ip != '0'))

stream_rules.title: AUTH-010 Создан Linux-пользователь
stream_rules.operator_action: Alert. Указать, что правило работает только если auth.log/sshd/sudo пересылается в SIEM через rsyslog/syslog.
stream_rules.description: AUTH-010: message contains [new user, useradd, adduser] Источники: auth.log.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.type == 'linux_user_created' or event.action == 'user_created' or event_action == 'user_created' or event.original icontains 'useradd[' or event.original icontains 'adduser[' or event.original icontains 'new user: name=') and not event.original icontains 'user.slice' and not event.original icontains 'new session' and not event.original icontains 'service_unit_modify' and not event.original icontains 'type=PATH' and not event.original icontains 'dpkg-' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and source.ip != '192.168.1.102' and source.ip != '10.20.30.122' and source.ip != '0')

stream_rules.title: AUTH-011 Удалён Linux-пользователь
stream_rules.operator_action: Alert. Указать, что правило работает только если auth.log/sshd/sudo пересылается в SIEM через rsyslog/syslog.
stream_rules.description: AUTH-011: message contains [delete user, userdel, deluser] Источники: auth.log.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.type == 'linux_user_deleted' or event.action == 'user_deleted' or event_action == 'user_deleted' or event.original icontains 'userdel[' or event.original icontains 'deluser[' or event.original icontains 'delete user' or event.original icontains 'removed user') and not event.original icontains 'type=PATH' and not event.original icontains 'nametype=DELETE' and not event.original icontains 'service_unit_modify' and not event.original icontains 'dpkg-' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and source.ip != '192.168.1.102' and source.ip != '10.20.30.122' and source.ip != '0')

stream_rules.title: AUTH-012 Изменён пароль root
stream_rules.detection_logic: passwd for root OR password changed for root
stream_rules.operator_action: Alert. Указать, что правило работает только если auth.log/sshd/sudo пересылается в SIEM через rsyslog/syslog.
stream_rules.description: AUTH-012: passwd for root OR password changed for root Источники: auth.log.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.type == 'linux_password_changed' or event.action == 'password_change' or event.provider == 'linux.passwd' or event.original icontains 'USER_CHAUTHTOK') and (user.target.name == 'root' or user.name == 'root' or event.original icontains 'acct="root"' or event.original icontains 'acct=root' or event.original icontains 'password changed for root') and event.outcome != 'failure' and event.type != 'audit_service_start' and event.type != 'audit_service_stop' and event.action != 'service_start' and event.action != 'service_stop' and process.name != 'systemd' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'e2e' and not log_source icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'assignment-full' and not log_source icontains 'assignment-full' and not host.name icontains 'validation' and not log_source icontains 'validation')

stream_rules.title: AUTH-013 su в root
stream_rules.detection_logic: su session opened for user root
stream_rules.operator_action: Alert. Указать, что правило работает только если auth.log/sshd/sudo пересылается в SIEM через rsyslog/syslog.
stream_rules.description: AUTH-013: su session opened for user root Источники: auth.log/su.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.su' or process.name == 'su' or event.original icontains ' su:') and event.original icontains 'session opened for user root' and not event.original icontains 'cron:session' and not event.original icontains 'sshd:session' and not event.original icontains 'systemd-user:session' and not event.original icontains 'pam_unix(sudo:session)' and not event.original icontains 'type=SERVICE_' and event.action != 'service_start' and event.action != 'service_stop' and process.name != 'systemd' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'e2e' and not log_source icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'assignment-full' and not log_source icontains 'assignment-full' and not host.name icontains 'validation' and not log_source icontains 'validation')

stream_rules.title: AUTH-014 Неуспешные su
stream_rules.operator_action: Alert. Указать, что правило работает только если auth.log/sshd/sudo пересылается в SIEM через rsyslog/syslog.
stream_rules.description: AUTH-014: su authentication failure count>=5 in 10m Источники: auth.log/su.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.su' or process.name == 'su' or event.original icontains ' su:') and (event.original icontains 'authentication failure' or event.original icontains 'pam_unix(su:auth)' or event.original icontains 'FAILED SU') and not event.original icontains 'sshd' and not event.original icontains 'sudo:' and not event.original icontains 'type=USER_LOGIN' and not event.original icontains 'type=USER_AUTH' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'e2e' and not log_source icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'assignment-full' and not log_source icontains 'assignment-full' and not host.name icontains 'validation' and not log_source icontains 'validation')

stream_rules.title: AUTH-015 SSH session opened to critical host
stream_rules.operator_action: Alert. Указать, что правило работает только если auth.log/sshd/sudo пересылается в SIEM через rsyslog/syslog.
stream_rules.description: AUTH-015: Accepted* AND host in critical_assets Источники: auth.log/sshd.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'linux.sshd' and (event.original icontains 'Accepted' or event.original icontains 'critical_assets' or event.original icontains 'ssh_login_success') and ((host.name icontains 'gamepanel-01' or log_source icontains 'gamepanel-01') or (host.name icontains 'lab-edge-01' or log_source icontains 'lab-edge-01') or (host.name icontains 'minecraft-01' or log_source icontains 'minecraft-01') or (host.name icontains 'navidrome-01' or log_source icontains 'navidrome-01') or (host.name icontains 'nextcloud-siem' or log_source icontains 'nextcloud-siem') or (host.name icontains 'openclaw-gateway' or log_source icontains 'openclaw-gateway') or (host.name icontains 'pilot-web-01' or log_source icontains 'pilot-web-01') or (host.name icontains 'siem-ingest' or log_source icontains 'siem-ingest') or (host.name icontains 'siem-processing' or log_source icontains 'siem-processing') or (host.name icontains 'siem-storage' or log_source icontains 'siem-storage')) and (not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and source.ip != '192.168.1.102' and source.ip != '10.20.30.122' and source.ip != '0'))

stream_rules.title: AUTH-016 SSH login from public internet
stream_rules.detection_logic: Accepted* AND src_ip is public AND src_ip not allowed_admin_ip
stream_rules.operator_action: Alert. Указать, что правило работает только если auth.log/sshd/sudo пересылается в SIEM через rsyslog/syslog.
stream_rules.description: AUTH-016: Accepted* AND src_ip is public AND src_ip not allowed_admin_ip Источники: auth.log/sshd.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'linux.sshd' and (event.original icontains 'Accepted' or event.original icontains 'src_ip' or event.original icontains 'public' or event.original icontains 'allowed_admin_ip' or event.original icontains 'ssh_login_success') and (not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and source.ip != '192.168.1.102' and source.ip != '10.20.30.122' and source.ip != '0'))

stream_rules.title: AUTH-017 PAM authentication errors spike
stream_rules.operator_action: Alert. Указать, что правило работает только если auth.log/sshd/sudo пересылается в SIEM через rsyslog/syslog.
stream_rules.description: AUTH-017: pam_* authentication failure count>=20 in 10m Источники: auth.log/PAM.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.type == 'pam_authentication_failure' or event.type == 'audit_user_auth_failure' or event.type == 'audit_user_acct_failure' or event.type == 'ssh_login_failure' or event.action == 'authentication_failed' or (((event.provider == 'linux.sshd' or event.provider == 'linux.sudo' or event.provider == 'linux.syslog' or event.provider == 'linux.pam') and (event.original icontains 'authentication failure' or event.original icontains 'pam_authenticate failed' or event.original icontains 'failed password')))) and event.outcome != 'success' and not event.type == 'audit_service_stop' and not event.type == 'audit_service_start' and not event.original icontains 'res=success' and not event.original icontains 'session opened' and not event.original icontains 'session closed' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e')

stream_rules.title: AUTH-018 SSH disconnect storm
stream_rules.operator_action: Alert. Указать, что правило работает только если auth.log/sshd/sudo пересылается в SIEM через rsyslog/syslog.
stream_rules.description: AUTH-018: disconnect/preauth count>=50 by src_ip in 10m Источники: auth.log/sshd.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'linux.sshd' and (event.original icontains 'disconnect/preauth' or event.original icontains 'src_ip' or event.original icontains '10m') and (not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and source.ip != '192.168.1.102' and source.ip != '10.20.30.122' and source.ip != '0'))

stream_rules.title: AUTH-020 Остановлен sshd
stream_rules.operator_action: Alert. Указать, что правило работает только если auth.log/sshd/sudo пересылается в SIEM через rsyslog/syslog.
stream_rules.description: AUTH-020: unit=ssh/sshd state=stopped/failed Источники: systemd/syslog.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'linux.sshd' and (event.original icontains 'unit' or event.original icontains 'ssh/sshd' or event.original icontains 'state' or event.original icontains 'stopped/failed' or event.original icontains 'Failed password' or event.original icontains 'ssh_login_failure' or event.original icontains 'stopped' or event.original icontains 'entered failed state') and (not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and source.ip != '192.168.1.102' and source.ip != '10.20.30.122' and source.ip != '0'))

stream_rules.title: SVC-001 Критичный service stopped
stream_rules.detection_logic: systemd unit state in [stopped,failed] AND unit in critical_services
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: SVC-001: systemd unit state in [stopped,failed] AND unit in critical_services Источники: systemd/journald via syslog, app logs.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'linux.systemd' and event.type == 'linux_systemd_unit_failed' and (service.name == 'nginx.service' or service.name == 'ssh.service' or service.name == 'sshd.service' or service.name == 'docker.service' or service.name == 'containerd.service' or service.name startswith 'postgresql' or service.name startswith 'clickhouse' or service.name startswith 'kafka' or service.name startswith 'redis' or service.name startswith 'valkey' or service.name startswith 'navidrome' or service.name startswith 'wings' or service.name startswith 'pterodactyl' or service.name startswith 'siem-' or service.name startswith 'pveproxy' or service.name startswith 'pvedaemon') and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e')

stream_rules.title: SVC-002 Критичный service restarted
stream_rules.detection_logic: unit restart AND unit in critical_services AND not maintenance_window
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: SVC-002: unit restart AND unit in critical_services AND not maintenance_window Источники: systemd/syslog.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.systemd' or event.provider == 'linux.syslog') and (event.original icontains 'unit' or event.original icontains 'restart' or event.original icontains 'critical_services' or event.original icontains 'maintenance_window' or event.original icontains 'stopped' or event.original icontains 'entered failed state') and ((host.name icontains 'siem-ingest' or log_source icontains 'siem-ingest') or (host.name icontains 'siem-processing' or log_source icontains 'siem-processing') or (host.name icontains 'siem-storage' or log_source icontains 'siem-storage') or (host.name icontains 'siem-transport' or log_source icontains 'siem-transport') or (host.name icontains 'siem-web' or log_source icontains 'siem-web')) and not tags icontains 'allowlist:')

stream_rules.title: SVC-003 Service restart loop
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: SVC-003: same unit restart count>=5 in 10m Источники: systemd/syslog.
stream_rules.expr: (((event.provider == 'linux.systemd' and event.type == 'linux_systemd_restart_scheduled') or (event.provider == 'linux.docker' and (event.original icontains 'crash loop' or event.original icontains 'Back-off restarting'))) and not event.original icontains 'apt.systemd.daily' and not event.original icontains 'unattended-upgrade' and not event.original icontains 'healthcheck' and not event.original icontains 'container-getty@' and not event.original icontains 'getty@' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e')

stream_rules.title: SVC-004 Unit entered failed state
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: SVC-004: message contains 'entered failed state' Источники: systemd/syslog.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'linux.systemd' and event.type == 'linux_systemd_unit_failed' and service.name != '' and service.name != 'nginx.service' and service.name != 'ssh.service' and service.name != 'sshd.service' and service.name != 'docker.service' and service.name != 'containerd.service' and not service.name startswith 'postgresql' and not service.name startswith 'clickhouse' and not service.name startswith 'kafka' and not service.name startswith 'redis' and not service.name startswith 'valkey' and not service.name startswith 'navidrome' and not service.name startswith 'wings' and not service.name startswith 'pterodactyl' and not service.name startswith 'siem-' and not service.name startswith 'pveproxy' and not service.name startswith 'pvedaemon' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e')

stream_rules.title: SVC-005 Dependency failed for service
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: SVC-005: message contains 'Dependency failed for' Источники: systemd/syslog.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.systemd' or event.provider == 'linux.syslog') and (event.original icontains 'Dependency failed for' or event.original icontains 'dependency job failed' or event.original icontains 'A dependency job for' or event.original icontains 'Job failed. See') and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'e2e' and not log_source icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'assignment-full' and not log_source icontains 'assignment-full' and not host.name icontains 'validation' and not log_source icontains 'validation')

stream_rules.title: SVC-006 OOMKilled service
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: SVC-006: message contains [Out of memory,Killed process] Источники: kernel/systemd logs.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.systemd' or event.provider == 'linux.syslog' or event.provider == 'linux.kernel') and (event.original icontains 'Out of memory' or event.original icontains 'Killed process' or event.original icontains 'oom-kill' or event.original icontains 'OOMKilled') and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'e2e' and not log_source icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'assignment-full' and not log_source icontains 'assignment-full' and not host.name icontains 'validation' and not log_source icontains 'validation')

stream_rules.title: SVC-007 Filesystem read-only
stream_rules.detection_logic: message contains [read-only file system, EXT4-fs error, remounting filesystem read-only]
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: SVC-007: message contains [read-only file system, EXT4-fs error, remounting filesystem read-only] Источники: kernel/systemd logs.
stream_rules.expr: (((host.name icontains 'siem-ingest' or log_source icontains 'siem-ingest') or (host.name icontains 'siem-processing' or log_source icontains 'siem-processing') or (host.name icontains 'siem-storage' or log_source icontains 'siem-storage') or (host.name icontains 'siem-transport' or log_source icontains 'siem-transport') or (host.name icontains 'siem-web' or log_source icontains 'siem-web')) and (event.provider == 'linux.kernel' or process.name == 'kernel' or event.original icontains 'kernel:') and (event.original icontains 'read-only file system' or event.original icontains 'EXT4-fs error' or event.original icontains 'remounting filesystem read-only') and not event.original icontains 'system-fp-remediation' and not event.original icontains 'publish_assignment_detection_pack.py' and not event.original icontains 'publish_rule_noise_tuning.py' and not event.original icontains 'ALTER TABLE siem.alerts_' and not event.original icontains 'UPDATE status=' and not event.original icontains 'sudo:' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:')

stream_rules.title: SVC-008 Kernel panic/oops
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: SVC-008: message contains [kernel panic, BUG:, Oops] Источники: kernel logs.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.systemd' or event.provider == 'linux.syslog') and (event.original icontains 'kernel panic' or event.original icontains 'BUG:' or event.original icontains 'Oops' or event.original icontains 'kernel' or event.original icontains 'panic' or event.original icontains 'stopped' or event.original icontains 'entered failed state') and ((host.name icontains 'siem-ingest' or log_source icontains 'siem-ingest') or (host.name icontains 'siem-processing' or log_source icontains 'siem-processing') or (host.name icontains 'siem-storage' or log_source icontains 'siem-storage') or (host.name icontains 'siem-transport' or log_source icontains 'siem-transport') or (host.name icontains 'siem-web' or log_source icontains 'siem-web')) and not tags icontains 'allowlist:')

stream_rules.title: SVC-009 Package manager transaction
stream_rules.scope: Linux with apt/yum logs to syslog
stream_rules.detection_logic: message contains [install, upgrade, remove] AND package manager
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: SVC-009: message contains [install, upgrade, remove] AND package manager Источники: apt/dpkg logs if collected.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.systemd' or event.provider == 'linux.syslog') and (event.original icontains 'install' or event.original icontains 'upgrade' or event.original icontains 'remove' or event.original icontains 'package' or event.original icontains 'manager' or event.original icontains 'stopped' or event.original icontains 'entered failed state') and ((host.name icontains 'siem-ingest' or log_source icontains 'siem-ingest') or (host.name icontains 'siem-processing' or log_source icontains 'siem-processing') or (host.name icontains 'siem-storage' or log_source icontains 'siem-storage') or (host.name icontains 'siem-transport' or log_source icontains 'siem-transport') or (host.name icontains 'siem-web' or log_source icontains 'siem-web')) and not tags icontains 'allowlist:')

stream_rules.title: SVC-010 Удалён monitoring/logging/security package
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: SVC-010: package removed AND package in [rsyslog,suricata,unbound,nginx,clickhouse,postgresql,docker] Источники: apt/dpkg/yum logs.
stream_rules.expr: (((event.type == 'linux_package_removed' or event.action == 'package_removed') or ((event.provider == 'linux.dpkg' or event.provider == 'linux.apt' or event.provider == 'linux.yum' or event.provider == 'linux.dnf') and (event.original icontains ' remove ' or event.original icontains 'removed package' or event.original icontains 'status not-installed'))) and (package.name == 'rsyslog' or package.name == 'suricata' or package.name == 'unbound' or package.name == 'nginx' or package.name == 'clickhouse-server' or package.name == 'postgresql' or package.name == 'docker-ce' or event.original icontains ' rsyslog' or event.original icontains ' suricata' or event.original icontains ' unbound' or event.original icontains ' nginx' or event.original icontains ' clickhouse-server' or event.original icontains ' postgresql' or event.original icontains ' docker-ce') and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e')

stream_rules.title: SVC-011 rsyslog stopped
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: SVC-011: unit=rsyslog state stopped/failed Источники: systemd/syslog.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.systemd' or event.provider == 'linux.syslog' or event.provider == 'linux.python' or event.provider == 'linux.docker') and (event.original icontains 'rsyslog' or event.original icontains 'System Logging Service') and (event.original icontains 'entered failed state' or event.original icontains 'failed with result' or event.original icontains 'Main process exited' or event.original icontains 'start request repeated too quickly' or event.original icontains 'Failed to start' or event.original icontains 'status=failed') and not event.original icontains 'Stopped System Logging Service' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:')

stream_rules.title: SVC-012 nginx stopped
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: SVC-012: unit=nginx state stopped/failed Источники: systemd/syslog.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.systemd' or event.provider == 'linux.syslog' or event.provider == 'linux.python') and (event.original icontains 'nginx.service' or event.original icontains ' nginx') and (event.original icontains 'entered failed state' or event.original icontains 'failed with result' or event.original icontains 'Main process exited' or event.original icontains 'start request repeated too quickly' or event.original icontains 'Failed to start' or event.original icontains 'status=failed' or event.original icontains 'status=1/FAILURE' or event.original icontains 'status=2/INVALIDARGUMENT') and not event.original icontains 'Stopped nginx' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'e2e' and not log_source icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'assignment-full' and not log_source icontains 'assignment-full' and not host.name icontains 'validation' and not log_source icontains 'validation')

stream_rules.title: SVC-013 postgresql stopped
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: SVC-013: unit=postgresql state stopped/failed Источники: systemd/syslog.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.systemd' or event.provider == 'linux.syslog' or event.provider == 'linux.python' or event.provider == 'linux.docker') and (event.original icontains 'postgresql' or event.original icontains 'postgresql@') and (event.original icontains 'entered failed state' or event.original icontains 'failed with result' or event.original icontains 'Main process exited' or event.original icontains 'start request repeated too quickly' or event.original icontains 'Failed to start' or event.original icontains 'status=failed') and not event.original icontains 'Stopped PostgreSQL' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:')

stream_rules.title: SVC-014 mongod stopped
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: SVC-014: unit=mongod state stopped/failed Источники: systemd/syslog.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.systemd' or event.provider == 'linux.syslog') and (event.original icontains 'unit' or event.original icontains 'mongod' or event.original icontains 'state' or event.original icontains 'stopped/failed' or event.original icontains 'stopped' or event.original icontains 'entered failed state') and ((host.name icontains 'siem-ingest' or log_source icontains 'siem-ingest') or (host.name icontains 'siem-processing' or log_source icontains 'siem-processing') or (host.name icontains 'siem-storage' or log_source icontains 'siem-storage') or (host.name icontains 'siem-transport' or log_source icontains 'siem-transport') or (host.name icontains 'siem-web' or log_source icontains 'siem-web')) and not tags icontains 'allowlist:')

stream_rules.title: SVC-015 qemu-guest-agent stopped
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: SVC-015: unit=qemu-guest-agent state stopped/failed Источники: systemd/syslog.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.systemd' or event.provider == 'linux.syslog') and (event.original icontains 'unit' or event.original icontains 'qemu-guest-agent' or event.original icontains 'state' or event.original icontains 'stopped/failed' or event.original icontains 'stopped' or event.original icontains 'entered failed state') and ((host.name icontains 'siem-ingest' or log_source icontains 'siem-ingest') or (host.name icontains 'siem-processing' or log_source icontains 'siem-processing') or (host.name icontains 'siem-storage' or log_source icontains 'siem-storage') or (host.name icontains 'siem-transport' or log_source icontains 'siem-transport') or (host.name icontains 'siem-web' or log_source icontains 'siem-web')) and not tags icontains 'allowlist:')

stream_rules.title: EDGE-001 Suricata stopped/failed
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: EDGE-001: unit=suricata stopped/failed Источники: systemd/syslog.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'linux.systemd' and event.type == 'linux_systemd_unit_failed' and service.name == 'suricata.service' and (host.name == 'lab-edge-01' or log_source == 'lab-edge-01') and not tags icontains 'allowlist:')

stream_rules.title: EDGE-002 Unbound stopped/failed
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: EDGE-002: unit=unbound stopped/failed Источники: systemd/syslog.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'linux.systemd' and event.type == 'linux_systemd_unit_failed' and service.name == 'unbound.service' and (host.name == 'lab-edge-01' or log_source == 'lab-edge-01') and not tags icontains 'allowlist:')

stream_rules.title: EDGE-003 rsyslog stopped/failed
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: EDGE-003: unit=rsyslog stopped/failed Источники: systemd/syslog.
stream_rules.expr: ((((event.provider == 'host.metrics' and event.type == 'host_service_down') and (service.name == 'rsyslog' or service.name == 'rsyslog.service')) or (event.provider == 'linux.systemd' and event.type == 'linux_systemd_unit_failed' and service.name == 'rsyslog.service')) and (host.name == 'lab-edge-01' or log_source == 'lab-edge-01') and not tags icontains 'allowlist:')

stream_rules.title: EDGE-006 Syslog relay перестал принимать события
stream_rules.detection_logic: received_messages=0 for 10m while expected senders active
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: EDGE-006: received_messages=0 for 10m while expected senders active Источники: rsyslog stats/app logs.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'host.metrics' and event.type == 'host_service_down' and (event.original icontains 'rsyslog' or event.original icontains 'syslog-ng') and ((host.name == 'lab-edge-01' or log_source == 'lab-edge-01') or (host.name == 'openclaw-gateway' or log_source == 'openclaw-gateway')) and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e')

stream_rules.title: IDS-001 Suricata alert severity 1
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: IDS-001: event_type=alert AND alert.severity=1 Источники: Suricata EVE JSON.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'suricata' and event.type == 'suricata_alert' and suricata.alert.severity == '1' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e')

stream_rules.title: IDS-002 Suricata alert severity 2
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: IDS-002: event_type=alert AND alert.severity=2 Источники: Suricata EVE JSON.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'suricata' and event.type == 'suricata_alert' and suricata.alert.severity == '2' and not rule.name startswith 'ET INFO' and not rule.category icontains 'Not Suspicious Traffic' and not rule.category icontains 'Potentially Bad Traffic' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e')

stream_rules.title: IDS-003 Exploit kit / RCE signature
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: IDS-003: alert.category/signature contains [Exploit,RCE,Shellcode,Web Application Attack] Источники: Suricata EVE JSON.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'suricata' and event.type == 'suricata_alert' and (rule.name icontains 'Exploit' or rule.name icontains 'RCE' or rule.name icontains 'Shellcode' or rule.category icontains 'Web Application Attack' or rule.category icontains 'Attempted Administrator Privilege Gain') and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e')

stream_rules.title: IDS-004 Malware C2 signature
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: IDS-004: alert.category/signature contains [C2,Trojan,Malware,Command and Control] Источники: Suricata EVE JSON.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'suricata' and event.type == 'suricata_alert' and (rule.name icontains 'Trojan' or rule.name icontains 'Malware' or rule.name icontains 'Command and Control' or rule.name icontains ' C2 ' or rule.category icontains 'A Network Trojan was Detected') and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e')

stream_rules.title: IDS-005 ET SCAN / portscan
stream_rules.detection_logic: alert.category/signature contains [Scan,Port Scan] OR unique dst_port>=20 by src_ip/dst_ip in 5m
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: IDS-005: alert.category/signature contains [Scan,Port Scan] OR unique dst_port>=20 by src_ip/dst_ip in 5m Источники: Suricata EVE JSON.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'suricata' and event.type == 'suricata_alert' and (rule.name icontains 'ET SCAN' or rule.name icontains 'Port Scan' or rule.name icontains 'Nmap' or rule.category icontains 'Attempted Information Leak') and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e')

stream_rules.title: IDS-006 SSH bruteforce from IDS perspective
stream_rules.detection_logic: dst_port=22 AND flow attempts>=20 by src_ip in 5m
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: IDS-006: dst_port=22 AND flow attempts>=20 by src_ip in 5m Источники: Suricata EVE/flow.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'suricata' and event.type == 'suricata_alert' and destination.port == '22' and (rule.name icontains 'SSH' or rule.name icontains 'Brute Force') and (rule.name icontains 'Scan' or rule.name icontains 'Brute' or rule.name icontains 'Password') and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e')

stream_rules.title: IDS-007 RDP scan/bruteforce
stream_rules.detection_logic: dst_port=3389 AND attempts>=10 by src_ip in 5m
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: IDS-007: dst_port=3389 AND attempts>=10 by src_ip in 5m Источники: Suricata EVE/flow.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'suricata' and event.type == 'suricata_alert' and destination.port == '3389' and (rule.name icontains 'RDP' or rule.name icontains 'Remote Desktop') and (rule.name icontains 'Scan' or rule.name icontains 'Brute') and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e')

stream_rules.title: IDS-008 Inbound to database ports
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: IDS-008: dst_port in [5432,27017,6379,8123,9000,9092] AND src_ip public Источники: Suricata flow/firewall logs.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'suricata' and (event.type == 'suricata_flow' or event.type == 'suricata_alert') and network.direction == 'inbound' and (destination.port == '5432' or destination.port == '27017' or destination.port == '6379' or destination.port == '8123' or destination.port == '9000' or destination.port == '9092') and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e')

stream_rules.title: IDS-009 Outbound to suspicious ports
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: IDS-009: src_host internal AND dst_port in [4444,5555,6667,1337,31337] Источники: Suricata flow.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'suricata' and (event.type == 'suricata_flow' or event.type == 'suricata_alert') and network.direction == 'outbound' and (destination.port == '4444' or destination.port == '5555' or destination.port == '6667' or destination.port == '1337' or destination.port == '31337') and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e')

stream_rules.title: IDS-010 Outbound to TOR/VPN/proxy
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: IDS-010: dst_ip/dst_domain in tor_vpn_proxy_feeds Источники: Suricata/DNS/IP reputation.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'suricata' and event.type == 'suricata_alert' and (rule.name icontains 'Tor ' or rule.name icontains 'Tor Exit' or rule.name icontains 'Anonymizer' or rule.name icontains 'VPN Service' or rule.name icontains 'Known VPN') and not rule.name startswith 'ET INFO' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e')

stream_rules.title: IDS-011 Crypto/mining pool traffic
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: IDS-011: dst_domain/signature contains [mining,pool,stratum,xmr] OR dst_port in [3333,4444,5555] Источники: Suricata/DNS.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'suricata' and event.type == 'suricata_alert' and (rule.name icontains 'Mining' or rule.name icontains 'Stratum' or rule.name icontains 'Cryptominer' or rule.name icontains 'XMRig' or rule.category icontains 'Cryptocurrency') and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e')

stream_rules.title: IDS-013 Internal lateral scan
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.

stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.python' or event.provider == 'linux.systemd') and (event.original icontains 'operation' or event.original icontains 'unseal') and ((host.name icontains 'iam/sso' or log_source icontains 'iam/sso') or (host.name icontains 'keycloak' or log_source icontains 'keycloak') or (host.name icontains 'siem' or log_source icontains 'siem') or (host.name icontains 'siem-ingest' or log_source icontains 'siem-ingest') or (host.name icontains 'siem-processing' or log_source icontains 'siem-processing') or (host.name icontains 'siem-storage' or log_source icontains 'siem-storage') or (host.name icontains 'siem-transport' or log_source icontains 'siem-transport') or (host.name icontains 'siem-web' or log_source icontains 'siem-web')) and not tags icontains 'allowlist:')

stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: VAULT-004: path contains /sys/policies OR operation policy write/delete Источники: siem-vault audit logs.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.python' or event.provider == 'linux.systemd') and (event.original icontains 'path' or event.original icontains '/sys/policies' or event.original icontains 'operation' or event.original icontains 'policy' or event.original icontains 'write/delete') and ((host.name icontains 'iam/sso' or log_source icontains 'iam/sso') or (host.name icontains 'keycloak' or log_source icontains 'keycloak') or (host.name icontains 'siem' or log_source icontains 'siem') or (host.name icontains 'siem-ingest' or log_source icontains 'siem-ingest') or (host.name icontains 'siem-processing' or log_source icontains 'siem-processing') or (host.name icontains 'siem-storage' or log_source icontains 'siem-storage') or (host.name icontains 'siem-transport' or log_source icontains 'siem-transport') or (host.name icontains 'siem-web' or log_source icontains 'siem-web')) and not tags icontains 'allowlist:')

stream_rules.title: PG-001 PostgreSQL auth failure spike
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: PG-001: authentication failed count>=10 in 10m Источники: postgresql logs.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.systemd' or event.provider == 'linux.python') and (event.original icontains 'authentication' or event.original icontains '10m') and ((host.name icontains 'pilot-cache-01' or log_source icontains 'pilot-cache-01') or (host.name icontains 'pilot-db-01' or log_source icontains 'pilot-db-01') or (host.name icontains 'pilot-web-01' or log_source icontains 'pilot-web-01') or (host.name icontains 'siem-ingest' or log_source icontains 'siem-ingest') or (host.name icontains 'siem-processing' or log_source icontains 'siem-processing') or (host.name icontains 'siem-storage' or log_source icontains 'siem-storage') or (host.name icontains 'siem-transport' or log_source icontains 'siem-transport') or (host.name icontains 'siem-web' or log_source icontains 'siem-web')) and not tags icontains 'allowlist:')

stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: PG-002: user in [postgres,admin] login success Источники: postgresql logs.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'postgresql' or event.provider == 'linux.postgresql' or event.type == 'postgresql_login_success' or event.action == 'postgresql_login_success' or event_action == 'postgresql_login_success') and (user.name == 'postgres' or user_name == 'postgres' or user.name == 'admin' or user_name == 'admin') and (event.original icontains 'connection authorized' or event.original icontains 'login' or event.type == 'postgresql_login_success') and not event.original icontains 'peer authentication' and not event.original icontains 'local socket' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:')

stream_rules.title: PG-003 PostgreSQL login from non-allowed host
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: PG-003: client_ip not in allowed_pg_clients Источники: postgresql logs.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.systemd' or event.provider == 'linux.python') and (event.original icontains 'client_ip' or event.original icontains 'allowed_pg_clients') and ((host.name icontains 'pilot-cache-01' or log_source icontains 'pilot-cache-01') or (host.name icontains 'pilot-db-01' or log_source icontains 'pilot-db-01') or (host.name icontains 'pilot-web-01' or log_source icontains 'pilot-web-01') or (host.name icontains 'siem-ingest' or log_source icontains 'siem-ingest') or (host.name icontains 'siem-processing' or log_source icontains 'siem-processing') or (host.name icontains 'siem-storage' or log_source icontains 'siem-storage') or (host.name icontains 'siem-transport' or log_source icontains 'siem-transport') or (host.name icontains 'siem-web' or log_source icontains 'siem-web')) and not tags icontains 'allowlist:')

stream_rules.title: PG-004 PostgreSQL DDL on app DB
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: PG-004: statement startswith [DROP,TRUNCATE,ALTER] on protected DB Источники: postgresql logs/audit if enabled.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.systemd' or event.provider == 'linux.python') and (event.original icontains 'DROP' or event.original icontains 'TRUNCATE' or event.original icontains 'ALTER' or event.original icontains 'statement' or event.original icontains 'startswith' or event.original icontains 'protected') and ((host.name icontains 'pilot-cache-01' or log_source icontains 'pilot-cache-01') or (host.name icontains 'pilot-db-01' or log_source icontains 'pilot-db-01') or (host.name icontains 'pilot-web-01' or log_source icontains 'pilot-web-01') or (host.name icontains 'siem-ingest' or log_source icontains 'siem-ingest') or (host.name icontains 'siem-processing' or log_source icontains 'siem-processing') or (host.name icontains 'siem-storage' or log_source icontains 'siem-storage') or (host.name icontains 'siem-transport' or log_source icontains 'siem-transport') or (host.name icontains 'siem-web' or log_source icontains 'siem-web')) and not tags icontains 'allowlist:')

stream_rules.title: PG-005 PostgreSQL mass export/copy
stream_rules.detection_logic: statement contains [COPY, pg_dump] OR long result/export
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: PG-005: statement contains [COPY, pg_dump] OR long result/export Источники: postgresql logs/audit if enabled.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.systemd' or event.provider == 'linux.python') and (event.original icontains 'COPY' or event.original icontains 'pg_dump' or event.original icontains 'statement' or event.original icontains 'long' or event.original icontains 'result/export') and ((host.name icontains 'pilot-cache-01' or log_source icontains 'pilot-cache-01') or (host.name icontains 'pilot-db-01' or log_source icontains 'pilot-db-01') or (host.name icontains 'pilot-web-01' or log_source icontains 'pilot-web-01') or (host.name icontains 'siem-ingest' or log_source icontains 'siem-ingest') or (host.name icontains 'siem-processing' or log_source icontains 'siem-processing') or (host.name icontains 'siem-storage' or log_source icontains 'siem-storage') or (host.name icontains 'siem-transport' or log_source icontains 'siem-transport') or (host.name icontains 'siem-web' or log_source icontains 'siem-web')) and not tags icontains 'allowlist:')

stream_rules.title: PG-006 PostgreSQL too many connections
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: PG-006: too many clients OR connections>threshold Источники: postgresql logs/metrics.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'postgresql' and event.type == 'postgresql_too_many_connections' and event.outcome == 'failure' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e')

stream_rules.title: PG-007 PostgreSQL slow query spike
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: PG-007: duration>30s count>=10 in 10m Источники: postgresql logs.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.systemd' or event.provider == 'linux.python') and (event.original icontains 'duration' or event.original icontains '30s' or event.original icontains '10m') and ((host.name icontains 'pilot-cache-01' or log_source icontains 'pilot-cache-01') or (host.name icontains 'pilot-db-01' or log_source icontains 'pilot-db-01') or (host.name icontains 'pilot-web-01' or log_source icontains 'pilot-web-01') or (host.name icontains 'siem-ingest' or log_source icontains 'siem-ingest') or (host.name icontains 'siem-processing' or log_source icontains 'siem-processing') or (host.name icontains 'siem-storage' or log_source icontains 'siem-storage') or (host.name icontains 'siem-transport' or log_source icontains 'siem-transport') or (host.name icontains 'siem-web' or log_source icontains 'siem-web')) and not tags icontains 'allowlist:')

stream_rules.title: PG-008 PostgreSQL restart/crash recovery
stream_rules.detection_logic: database system was interrupted OR crash recovery
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: PG-008: database system was interrupted OR crash recovery Источники: postgresql logs.
stream_rules.expr: (((event.provider == 'postgresql' or event.provider == 'linux.postgresql' or event.provider == 'linux.docker') and (host.name == 'pilot-db-01' or log_source == 'pilot-db-01' or host.name == 'siem-web' or log_source == 'siem-web' or host.name == 'siem-ingest' or log_source == 'siem-ingest')) and (event.original icontains 'database system was interrupted' or event.original icontains 'automatic recovery in progress' or event.original icontains 'invalid primary checkpoint record' or event.original icontains 'PANIC:' or event.original icontains 'redo starts at') and not event.original icontains 'database system is ready to accept connections' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:')

stream_rules.title: PG-009 PostgreSQL config reload failed
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: PG-009: configuration file contains errors Источники: postgresql logs.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'postgresql' or event.provider == 'linux.systemd' or event.provider == 'linux.python') and (host.name == 'pilot-db-01' or log_source == 'pilot-db-01' or host.name == 'siem-web' or log_source == 'siem-web') and (event.original icontains 'configuration reload failed' or event.original icontains 'could not reload' or event.original icontains 'invalid value for parameter' or event.original icontains 'FATAL:  configuration file') and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'e2e' and not log_source icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'assignment-full' and not log_source icontains 'assignment-full' and not host.name icontains 'validation' and not log_source icontains 'validation')

stream_rules.title: PG-010 PostgreSQL role/grant changed

stream_rules.expr: (((event.type == 'database_dump_created' or tags icontains 'detection:database_dump') or ((event.provider icontains 'backup' or event.provider icontains 'database') and (event.original icontains 'pg_dump' or event.original icontains 'mongodump' or event.original icontains 'mysqldump' or event.original icontains 'database dump'))) and (file.path startswith '/var/www/' or file.path startswith '/opt/app/public/' or file.path startswith '/tmp/' or event.original icontains '/var/www/' or event.original icontains '/opt/app/public/' or event.original icontains '/tmp/') and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e')

stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.docker' or event.provider == 'linux.systemd') and (event.original icontains 'docker.service' or event.original icontains 'dockerd' or event.original icontains 'containerd.service') and (event.original icontains 'entered failed state' or event.original icontains 'failed with result' or event.original icontains 'Main process exited' or event.original icontains 'start request repeated too quickly' or event.original icontains 'Failed to start' or event.original icontains 'status=failed' or event.original icontains 'status=1/FAILURE' or event.original icontains 'status=2/INVALIDARGUMENT') and not event.original icontains 'Stopped Docker' and not event.original icontains 'Deactivated successfully' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'e2e' and not log_source icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'assignment-full' and not log_source icontains 'assignment-full' and not host.name icontains 'validation' and not log_source icontains 'validation')

stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'linux.docker' and (event.original icontains 'container create' or event.original icontains 'action=create' or event.original icontains 'event=create') and not event.original icontains 'healthcheck' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'e2e' and not log_source icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'assignment-full' and not log_source icontains 'assignment-full' and not host.name icontains 'validation' and not log_source icontains 'validation')

stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'linux.docker' and (event.original icontains 'image not in approved' or event.original icontains 'new image' or event.original icontains 'pull complete' or event.original icontains 'action=pull') and not event.original icontains 'approved_images check ok' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'e2e' and not log_source icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'assignment-full' and not log_source icontains 'assignment-full' and not host.name icontains 'validation' and not log_source icontains 'validation')
