stream_rules.title: DCK-009 Sensitive host path mounted
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: DCK-009: mount source in [/etc,/root,/var/lib,/home,/opt/siem,/var/run] Источники: docker events/API audit.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.docker' or event.provider == 'linux.systemd') and (event.original icontains '/etc' or event.original icontains '/root' or event.original icontains '/var/lib' or event.original icontains '/home' or event.original icontains '/opt/siem' or event.original icontains '/var/run' or event.original icontains 'mount') and ((host.name icontains 'gamepanel-01' or log_source icontains 'gamepanel-01') or (host.name icontains 'minecraft-01' or log_source icontains 'minecraft-01') or (host.name icontains 'navidrome-01' or log_source icontains 'navidrome-01') or (host.name icontains 'nextcloud-siem' or log_source icontains 'nextcloud-siem') or (host.name icontains 'openclaw-gateway' or log_source icontains 'openclaw-gateway') or (host.name icontains 'pilot-cache-01' or log_source icontains 'pilot-cache-01') or (host.name icontains 'pilot-db-01' or log_source icontains 'pilot-db-01') or (host.name icontains 'pilot-web-01' or log_source icontains 'pilot-web-01') or (host.name icontains 'siem-ingest' or log_source icontains 'siem-ingest') or (host.name icontains 'siem-processing' or log_source icontains 'siem-processing')) and (not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not event.original icontains 'healthcheck'))

stream_rules.title: DCK-010 Container restart loop
stream_rules.detection_logic: die/start count>=5 for same container in 10m
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: DCK-010: die/start count>=5 for same container in 10m Источники: docker events.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.docker' or event.provider == 'linux.systemd') and (event.original icontains 'container' or event.original icontains 'docker') and (event.original icontains 'Scheduled restart job' or event.original icontains 'restart counter' or event.original icontains 'start request repeated too quickly' or event.original icontains 'crash loop' or event.original icontains 'Back-off restarting') and not event.original icontains 'healthcheck' and not event.original icontains 'container-getty@' and not event.original icontains 'getty@' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'e2e' and not log_source icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'assignment-full' and not log_source icontains 'assignment-full' and not host.name icontains 'validation' and not log_source icontains 'validation')

stream_rules.title: DCK-011 Container exited unexpectedly
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: DCK-011: event=die AND exitCode not in [0,143] Источники: docker events.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'linux.docker' and (event.original icontains 'container die' or event.original icontains 'event=die' or event.original icontains 'exitCode=1' or event.original icontains 'exitCode=2' or event.original icontains 'exitCode=137' or event.original icontains 'OOMKilled') and not event.original icontains 'exitCode=0' and not event.original icontains 'exitCode=143' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'e2e' and not log_source icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'assignment-full' and not log_source icontains 'assignment-full' and not host.name icontains 'validation' and not log_source icontains 'validation')

stream_rules.title: DCK-012 Image pulled from unapproved registry
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: DCK-012: registry not in approved_registries Источники: docker events/daemon logs.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.docker' or event.provider == 'linux.systemd') and (event.original icontains 'registry' or event.original icontains 'approved_registries') and ((host.name icontains 'gamepanel-01' or log_source icontains 'gamepanel-01') or (host.name icontains 'minecraft-01' or log_source icontains 'minecraft-01') or (host.name icontains 'navidrome-01' or log_source icontains 'navidrome-01') or (host.name icontains 'nextcloud-siem' or log_source icontains 'nextcloud-siem') or (host.name icontains 'openclaw-gateway' or log_source icontains 'openclaw-gateway') or (host.name icontains 'pilot-cache-01' or log_source icontains 'pilot-cache-01') or (host.name icontains 'pilot-db-01' or log_source icontains 'pilot-db-01') or (host.name icontains 'pilot-web-01' or log_source icontains 'pilot-web-01') or (host.name icontains 'vuln-mgr-01' or log_source icontains 'vuln-mgr-01')) and (not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not event.original icontains 'healthcheck'))

stream_rules.title: DCK-013 Docker login performed
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: DCK-013: message contains docker login/auth Источники: docker daemon logs.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'linux.docker' and (event.type == 'docker_registry_login' or event.action == 'registry_login' or event.original icontains 'Login Succeeded') and not event.original icontains 'login/auth' and not event.original icontains 'healthcheck' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e')

stream_rules.title: DCK-014 Docker API exposed
stream_rules.detection_logic: port 2375/2376 open OR connection to Docker API from non-local
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: DCK-014: port 2375/2376 open OR connection to Docker API from non-local Источники: Suricata/Nmap/docker daemon logs.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.docker' or event.provider == 'linux.suricata-eve' or event.provider == 'linux.nmap' or event.provider == 'openvas.finding') and ((event.original icontains 'tcp://0.0.0.0:2375' or event.original icontains 'tcp://0.0.0.0:2376' or event.original icontains '-H tcp://' or (event.original icontains 'dockerd' and (event.original icontains ':2375' or event.original icontains ':2376')) or event.original icontains '"dest_port":2375' or event.original icontains '"dest_port":2376' or event.original icontains '"destination":{"port":2375' or event.original icontains '"destination":{"port":2376' or event.original icontains 'dst_port=2375' or event.original icontains 'dst_port=2376' or (event.original icontains 'Docker API' and event.original icontains 'non-local'))) and not event.original icontains 'transaction 2375' and not event.original icontains 'transaction 2376' and not event.original icontains 'container-getty@' and not event.original icontains 'Host runtime snapshot' and not event.provider == 'linux.systemd-resolved' and not event.provider == 'linux.systemd' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'e2e' and not log_source icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'assignment-full' and not log_source icontains 'assignment-full' and not host.name icontains 'validation' and not log_source icontains 'validation')

stream_rules.title: DCK-015 Container logs contain fatal/panic
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: DCK-015: level in [fatal,panic] count>=1 Источники: container logs.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.docker' or event.provider == 'linux.systemd') and (event.original icontains ' fatal ' or event.original icontains 'panic' or event.original icontains 'level=fatal' or event.original icontains '"level":"fatal"') and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'e2e' and not log_source icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'assignment-full' and not log_source icontains 'assignment-full' and not host.name icontains 'validation' and not log_source icontains 'validation')

stream_rules.title: DCK-016 Container logs error spike
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: DCK-016: level=error count>=50 in 10m Источники: container logs.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.docker' or event.provider == 'linux.systemd') and (event.original icontains 'level' or event.original icontains '10m') and ((host.name icontains 'gamepanel-01' or log_source icontains 'gamepanel-01') or (host.name icontains 'minecraft-01' or log_source icontains 'minecraft-01') or (host.name icontains 'navidrome-01' or log_source icontains 'navidrome-01') or (host.name icontains 'nextcloud-siem' or log_source icontains 'nextcloud-siem') or (host.name icontains 'openclaw-gateway' or log_source icontains 'openclaw-gateway') or (host.name icontains 'pilot-cache-01' or log_source icontains 'pilot-cache-01') or (host.name icontains 'pilot-db-01' or log_source icontains 'pilot-db-01') or (host.name icontains 'pilot-web-01' or log_source icontains 'pilot-web-01') or (host.name icontains 'vuln-mgr-01' or log_source icontains 'vuln-mgr-01')) and (not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not event.original icontains 'healthcheck'))

stream_rules.title: DCK-017 Docker prune/remove image/container
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: DCK-017: event in [destroy,delete,prune,rmi] Источники: docker events.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'linux.docker' and (event.original icontains 'prune' or event.original icontains 'container destroy' or event.original icontains 'image destroy' or event.original icontains 'action=destroy' or event.original icontains ' docker rmi ') and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'e2e' and not log_source icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'assignment-full' and not log_source icontains 'assignment-full' and not host.name icontains 'validation' and not log_source icontains 'validation')

stream_rules.title: DCK-018 OpenVAS container down
stream_rules.detection_logic: container name matches [gsa,gvmd,openvas,ospd,redis] AND status down
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: DCK-018: container name matches [gsa,gvmd,openvas,ospd,redis] AND status down Источники: docker events/container health.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.docker' or event.provider == 'linux.systemd') and (host.name == 'vuln-mgr-01' or log_source == 'vuln-mgr-01') and (event.original icontains 'openvas' or event.original icontains 'gvmd' or event.original icontains 'ospd' or event.original icontains 'gsa') and (event.original icontains 'entered failed state' or event.original icontains 'failed with result' or event.original icontains 'Main process exited' or event.original icontains 'start request repeated too quickly' or event.original icontains 'Failed to start' or event.original icontains 'status=failed' or event.original icontains 'status=1/FAILURE' or event.original icontains 'status=2/INVALIDARGUMENT' or event.original icontains 'unhealthy' or event.original icontains 'container die' or event.original icontains 'exited') and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'e2e' and not log_source icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'assignment-full' and not log_source icontains 'assignment-full' and not host.name icontains 'validation' and not log_source icontains 'validation')

stream_rules.title: DCK-019 OpenClaw gateway container down
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: DCK-019: gateway/proxy container status down Источники: docker events/container health.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.docker' or event.provider == 'linux.systemd') and (host.name == 'openclaw-gateway' or log_source == 'openclaw-gateway') and (event.original icontains 'openclaw' or event.original icontains 'gateway' or event.original icontains 'proxy') and (event.original icontains 'entered failed state' or event.original icontains 'failed with result' or event.original icontains 'Main process exited' or event.original icontains 'start request repeated too quickly' or event.original icontains 'Failed to start' or event.original icontains 'status=failed' or event.original icontains 'status=1/FAILURE' or event.original icontains 'status=2/INVALIDARGUMENT' or event.original icontains 'unhealthy' or event.original icontains 'container die' or event.original icontains 'exited') and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'e2e' and not log_source icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'assignment-full' and not log_source icontains 'assignment-full' and not host.name icontains 'validation' and not log_source icontains 'validation')

stream_rules.title: DCK-020 Pilot cache container down
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: DCK-020: cache container status down Источники: docker events/container health.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.systemd' or event.provider == 'linux.syslog' or event.provider == 'linux.python' or event.provider == 'linux.docker') and (host.name == 'pilot-cache-01' or log_source == 'pilot-cache-01') and (event.original icontains 'redis' or event.original icontains 'valkey' or event.original icontains 'cache') and (event.original icontains 'unhealthy' or event.original icontains 'exited' or event.original icontains 'container die' or event.original icontains 'entered failed state' or event.original icontains 'failed with result' or event.original icontains 'Main process exited' or event.original icontains 'start request repeated too quickly' or event.original icontains 'Failed to start' or event.original icontains 'status=failed' or event.original icontains 'status=1/FAILURE' or event.original icontains 'status=2/INVALIDARGUMENT') and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'e2e' and not log_source icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'assignment-full' and not log_source icontains 'assignment-full' and not host.name icontains 'validation' and not log_source icontains 'validation')

stream_rules.title: DCK-021 Gamepanel/Wings container down
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: DCK-021: pterodactyl/wings container status down Источники: docker events/container health.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.docker' or event.provider == 'linux.systemd' or event.provider == 'linux.wings' or event.provider == 'linux.gamepanel-wings') and (host.name == 'gamepanel-01' or log_source == 'gamepanel-01') and (event.original icontains 'pterodactyl' or event.original icontains 'wings.service' or event.original icontains 'gamepanel-wings') and (event.original icontains 'entered failed state' or event.original icontains 'failed with result' or event.original icontains 'Main process exited' or event.original icontains 'start request repeated too quickly' or event.original icontains 'Failed to start' or event.original icontains 'status=failed' or event.original icontains 'status=1/FAILURE' or event.original icontains 'status=2/INVALIDARGUMENT' or event.original icontains 'unhealthy' or event.original icontains 'container die' or event.original icontains 'exited') and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'e2e' and not log_source icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'assignment-full' and not log_source icontains 'assignment-full' and not host.name icontains 'validation' and not log_source icontains 'validation')

stream_rules.title: DCK-022 Container started with new published port
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: DCK-022: published_port not in approved_ports Источники: docker events/API audit.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.docker' or event.provider == 'linux.systemd') and (event.original icontains 'published_port' or event.original icontains 'approved_ports') and ((host.name icontains 'gamepanel-01' or log_source icontains 'gamepanel-01') or (host.name icontains 'minecraft-01' or log_source icontains 'minecraft-01') or (host.name icontains 'navidrome-01' or log_source icontains 'navidrome-01') or (host.name icontains 'nextcloud-siem' or log_source icontains 'nextcloud-siem') or (host.name icontains 'openclaw-gateway' or log_source icontains 'openclaw-gateway') or (host.name icontains 'pilot-cache-01' or log_source icontains 'pilot-cache-01') or (host.name icontains 'pilot-db-01' or log_source icontains 'pilot-db-01') or (host.name icontains 'pilot-web-01' or log_source icontains 'pilot-web-01') or (host.name icontains 'vuln-mgr-01' or log_source icontains 'vuln-mgr-01')) and (not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not event.original icontains 'healthcheck'))

stream_rules.title: DCK-023 Container env contains visible secret in logs
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: DCK-023: log contains patterns [AWS_SECRET,PRIVATE KEY,password=,token=] Источники: docker/container logs.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.docker' or event.provider == 'linux.containerd') and (event.original icontains 'AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=' or event.original icontains '-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----' or event.original icontains '-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----' or event.original icontains 'password=' or event.original icontains 'token=') and not event.original icontains 'Password Requests' and not event.original icontains 'healthcheck' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:')

stream_rules.title: DCK-024 Container CPU/RAM high
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: DCK-024: container_cpu>90% OR memory>90% for 10m Источники: docker metrics if collected.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.docker' or event.provider == 'docker.metrics' or event.type == 'docker_container_metrics') and (event.original icontains 'container_cpu' or event.original icontains 'container_memory' or event.original icontains 'memory_pct' or event.original icontains 'cpu_pct') and not event.original icontains 'healthcheck' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:')

stream_rules.title: DCK-025 Docker disk usage high
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: DCK-025: /var/lib/docker usage>85% Источники: docker/system metrics.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.docker' or event.provider == 'linux.systemd') and (event.original icontains '/var/lib/docker' or event.original icontains 'usage') and ((host.name icontains 'gamepanel-01' or log_source icontains 'gamepanel-01') or (host.name icontains 'minecraft-01' or log_source icontains 'minecraft-01') or (host.name icontains 'navidrome-01' or log_source icontains 'navidrome-01') or (host.name icontains 'nextcloud-siem' or log_source icontains 'nextcloud-siem') or (host.name icontains 'openclaw-gateway' or log_source icontains 'openclaw-gateway') or (host.name icontains 'pilot-cache-01' or log_source icontains 'pilot-cache-01') or (host.name icontains 'pilot-db-01' or log_source icontains 'pilot-db-01') or (host.name icontains 'pilot-web-01' or log_source icontains 'pilot-web-01') or (host.name icontains 'vuln-mgr-01' or log_source icontains 'vuln-mgr-01')) and (not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not event.original icontains 'healthcheck'))

stream_rules.title: VULN-001 OpenVAS/GVM UI unavailable
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: VULN-001: gsad/gvm web health failed Источники: container health/nginx/app logs.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.python' or event.provider == 'linux.systemd') and (event.original icontains 'gsad/gvm' or event.original icontains 'web' or event.original icontains 'health') and (host.name icontains 'vuln-mgr-01' or log_source icontains 'vuln-mgr-01') and (not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and source.ip != '192.168.1.102' and source.ip != '10.20.30.122' and source.ip != '0'))

stream_rules.title: VULN-002 OpenVAS scan started
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: VULN-002: scan/task status=start Источники: GVM/OpenVAS container logs/API export.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.python' or event.provider == 'linux.systemd') and (event.original icontains 'scan/task' or event.original icontains 'start') and (host.name icontains 'vuln-mgr-01' or log_source icontains 'vuln-mgr-01') and (not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and source.ip != '192.168.1.102' and source.ip != '10.20.30.122' and source.ip != '0'))

stream_rules.title: VULN-003 OpenVAS scan outside window
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: VULN-003: scan_started AND not in scan_window Источники: GVM/OpenVAS logs.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.python' or event.provider == 'linux.systemd') and (event.original icontains 'scan_started' or event.original icontains 'scan_window') and (host.name icontains 'vuln-mgr-01' or log_source icontains 'vuln-mgr-01') and (not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and source.ip != '192.168.1.102' and source.ip != '10.20.30.122' and source.ip != '0'))

stream_rules.title: VULN-004 OpenVAS scans unapproved range
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: VULN-004: scan.target not in approved_scan_ranges Источники: GVM task target data.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.python' or event.provider == 'linux.systemd') and (event.original icontains 'scan.target' or event.original icontains 'approved_scan_ranges') and (host.name icontains 'vuln-mgr-01' or log_source icontains 'vuln-mgr-01') and (not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and source.ip != '192.168.1.102' and source.ip != '10.20.30.122' and source.ip != '0'))

stream_rules.title: VULN-005 New scan target created
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: VULN-005: target create Источники: GVM audit/API logs.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.provider == 'linux.python' or event.provider == 'linux.systemd') and (event.original icontains 'target' or event.original icontains 'create') and (host.name icontains 'vuln-mgr-01' or log_source icontains 'vuln-mgr-01') and (not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and source.ip != '192.168.1.102' and source.ip != '10.20.30.122' and source.ip != '0'))

stream_rules.title: VULN-006 Scan target changed
stream_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
stream_rules.description: VULN-006: target update Источники: GVM audit/API logs.

batch_rules.title: HB-001 Нет событий от хоста 24 часа
batch_rules.sources: SIEM last_seen, syslog, Windows agent, app logs
batch_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
batch_rules.description: HB-001: last_seen(host) < now-24h; исключить planned_offline=true Источники: SIEM last_seen, syslog, Windows agent, app logs.
batch_rules.sql_template:
INSERT INTO siem.alerts_raw
(ts, alert_id, rule_id, rule_name, severity, ts_first, ts_last, window_s, entity_key, hits, context_json, source, status)
SELECT
    now(),
    generateUUIDv4(),
    8001,
    'Нет событий от хоста 24 часа',
    'medium',
    candidate.ts_first,
    candidate.ts_last,
    {WINDOW_S},
    candidate.entity_key,
    candidate.hits,
    candidate.context_json,
    candidate.source,
    'open'
FROM
(
    SELECT
        heartbeat.hostname AS entity_key,
        heartbeat.hostname AS source,
        heartbeat.last_seen_ts AS ts_first,
        heartbeat.last_seen_ts AS ts_last,
        1 AS hits,
        concat(
            '{"event_type":"source_silence","source_id":"HB-001",',
            '"source":"', heartbeat.hostname, '","last_seen":"',
            toString(heartbeat.last_seen_ts), '","silence_hours":24}'
        ) AS context_json
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            c.hostname AS hostname,
            max(e.last_seen_ts) AS last_seen_ts
        FROM siem.cmdb_assets AS c FINAL
        INNER JOIN
        (
            SELECT
                lowerUTF8(if(host_name != '' AND host_name != '-', host_name, log_source)) AS host_key,
                max(ts) AS last_seen_ts
            FROM siem.events
            PREWHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
            WHERE if(host_name != '' AND host_name != '-', host_name, log_source) != ''
              AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'benchmark') = 0
              AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'synthetic') = 0
              AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'e2e') = 0

INSERT INTO siem.alerts_raw

    SELECT
        IPv4NumToString(e.src_ip) AS entity_key,

      AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(e.tags), 'synthetic') = 0

batch_rules.title: HB-011 Host отправляет слишком много событий
batch_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
batch_rules.description: HB-011: eps(host)>baseline(host)*5 for 10m Источники: SIEM EPS counters.
batch_rules.sql_template:
INSERT INTO siem.alerts_raw
(ts, alert_id, rule_id, rule_name, severity, ts_first, ts_last, window_s, entity_key, hits, context_json, source, status)
SELECT
    now(),
    generateUUIDv4(),
    8011,
    'Host отправляет слишком много событий',
    'high',
    candidate.ts_first,
    candidate.ts_last,
    {WINDOW_S},
    candidate.entity_key,
    candidate.hits,
    candidate.context_json,
    candidate.source,
    'open'
FROM
(
    WITH recent AS
    (
        SELECT
            if(host_name != '' AND host_name != '-', host_name, log_source) AS entity_key,
            count() AS recent_hits,
            min(ts) AS ts_first,
            max(ts) AS ts_last
        FROM siem.events
        PREWHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL {WINDOW_S} SECOND
        WHERE if(host_name != '' AND host_name != '-', host_name, log_source) != ''
          AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'allowlist:') = 0
          AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'benchmark') = 0
          AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'synthetic') = 0
          AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'e2e') = 0
        GROUP BY entity_key
    ), baseline AS
    (
        SELECT
            if(host_name != '' AND host_name != '-', host_name, log_source) AS entity_key,
            greatest(count() / 144, 1) AS baseline_10m
        FROM siem.events
        PREWHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
        WHERE ts < now() - INTERVAL {WINDOW_S} SECOND
          AND if(host_name != '' AND host_name != '-', host_name, log_source) != ''
          AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'allowlist:') = 0
          AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'benchmark') = 0
          AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'synthetic') = 0
          AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'e2e') = 0
        GROUP BY entity_key
    )
    SELECT
        r.entity_key AS entity_key,
        r.entity_key AS source,
        r.ts_first AS ts_first,
        r.ts_last AS ts_last,
        r.recent_hits AS hits,
        concat(
            '{"event_type":"host_volume_spike","source_id":"HB-011","source":"',
            r.entity_key, '","recent_hits":', toString(r.recent_hits),
            ',"baseline_10m":', toString(b.baseline_10m), '}'
        ) AS context_json
    FROM recent AS r
    INNER JOIN baseline AS b ON r.entity_key = b.entity_key
    WHERE b.baseline_10m >= 100
      AND r.recent_hits >= greatest(toUInt64(100000), toUInt64(b.baseline_10m * 20))
) AS candidate
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT entity_key
    FROM siem.alerts_raw
    WHERE rule_id = 8011
      AND ts >= now() - INTERVAL 86400 SECOND
      AND lower(status) IN ('open', 'false_positive', 'suppressed')
    GROUP BY entity_key
) AS existing
ON candidate.entity_key = existing.entity_key
WHERE existing.entity_key = ''

batch_rules.sql_template:

(ts, alert_id, rule_id, rule_name, severity, ts_first, ts_last, window_s, entity_key, hits, context_json, source, status)

    generateUUIDv4(),
    8012,
    'Host резко перестал отправлять события',

    candidate.ts_last,
    {WINDOW_S},
    candidate.entity_key,
    candidate.hits,
    candidate.context_json,
    candidate.source,
    'open'
FROM
(
    SELECT
        entity_key,
        source,
        ts_first,
        ts_last,
        hits,
        context_json
    FROM
    (
        WITH recent AS
        (
            SELECT
                if(host_name != '' AND host_name != '-', host_name, log_source) AS entity_key,
                count() AS recent_hits
            FROM siem.events
            PREWHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL {WINDOW_S} SECOND
            WHERE if(host_name != '' AND host_name != '-', host_name, log_source) != ''
              AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'allowlist:') = 0
              AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'benchmark') = 0
              AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'synthetic') = 0
              AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'e2e') = 0
            GROUP BY entity_key
        ), baseline AS
        (
            SELECT
                if(host_name != '' AND host_name != '-', host_name, log_source) AS entity_key,
                greatest(count() / 23, 1) AS baseline_1h
            FROM siem.events
            PREWHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
            WHERE ts < now() - INTERVAL {WINDOW_S} SECOND
              AND if(host_name != '' AND host_name != '-', host_name, log_source) != ''
              AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'allowlist:') = 0
              AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'benchmark') = 0
              AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'synthetic') = 0
              AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'e2e') = 0
            GROUP BY entity_key
        )
        SELECT
            b.entity_key AS entity_key,
            b.entity_key AS source,
            now() - INTERVAL {WINDOW_S} SECOND AS ts_first,
            now() AS ts_last,
            toUInt64(ifNull(r.recent_hits, 0)) AS hits,
            concat(
                '{"event_type":"host_volume_drop","source_id":"HB-012","source":"',
                b.entity_key, '","recent_hits":', toString(ifNull(r.recent_hits, 0)),
                ',"baseline_1h":', toString(b.baseline_1h), '}'
            ) AS context_json,
            count() OVER () AS dropped_entities
        FROM baseline AS b
        LEFT JOIN recent AS r ON r.entity_key = b.entity_key
        INNER JOIN siem.cmdb_assets AS c FINAL ON lowerUTF8(c.hostname) = lowerUTF8(b.entity_key)
        WHERE c.enabled = 1
          AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(c.tags, 'planned_offline') = 0
          AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(c.tags, 'bursty-telemetry') = 0
          AND lowerUTF8(b.entity_key) NOT IN ('opnsense-staging', '127.0.0.1')
          AND b.baseline_1h >= 500
          AND ifNull(r.recent_hits, 0) < greatest(toUInt64(5), toUInt64(b.baseline_1h * 0.01))
    )
    WHERE dropped_entities <= 2
) AS candidate
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT entity_key
    FROM siem.alerts_raw
    WHERE rule_id = 8012
      AND ts >= now() - INTERVAL 604800 SECOND
      AND lower(status) IN ('open', 'false_positive', 'suppressed')
    GROUP BY entity_key
) AS existing
ON candidate.entity_key = existing.entity_key
WHERE existing.entity_key = ''

    ), known AS

(

            max(ts) AS baseline_last

        GROUP BY entity_key
    ), recent_suricata AS
    (
        SELECT
            if(host_name != '' AND host_name != '-', host_name, log_source) AS entity_key,
            count() AS recent_hits,
            min(ts) AS ts_first,
            max(ts) AS ts_last
        FROM siem.events
        WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL {WINDOW_S} SECOND
          AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'allowlist:') = 0
          AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'benchmark') = 0
          AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'synthetic') = 0
          AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'e2e') = 0
          AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(lowerUTF8(if(host_name != '' AND host_name != '-', host_name, log_source)), 'e2e') = 0
          AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(lowerUTF8(if(host_name != '' AND host_name != '-', host_name, log_source)), 'assignment-full') = 0

          AND device_product = 'linux.suricata-eve'
          AND lowerUTF8(if(host_name != '' AND host_name != '-', host_name, log_source)) = 'lab-edge-01'
        GROUP BY entity_key
    ), recent_edge AS
    (
        SELECT
            if(host_name != '' AND host_name != '-', host_name, log_source) AS entity_key,

        FROM siem.events
        WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL {WINDOW_S} SECOND

          AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'synthetic') = 0

batch_rules.sql_template:
INSERT INTO siem.alerts_raw
(ts, alert_id, rule_id, rule_name, severity, ts_first, ts_last, window_s, entity_key, hits, context_json, source, status)

    8211,
    'CORR-S-001 Stream correlator alert spike',
    'medium',
    candidate.ts_first,
    candidate.ts_last,
    {WINDOW_S},
    candidate.entity_key,
    candidate.hits,
    candidate.context_json,
    candidate.source,
    'open'
FROM
(
    WITH recent AS
    (
        SELECT toString(rule_id) AS entity_key, count() AS recent_alerts, min(ts) AS ts_first, max(ts) AS ts_last
        FROM siem.alerts_raw
        WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL {WINDOW_S} SECOND
          AND rule_id NOT IN (8211,8212,8216)
        GROUP BY rule_id
    ), baseline AS
    (
        SELECT toString(rule_id) AS entity_key, greatest(count() / 288, 1) AS baseline_5m
        FROM siem.alerts_raw
        WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND ts < now() - INTERVAL {WINDOW_S} SECOND
          AND rule_id NOT IN (8211,8212,8216)
        GROUP BY rule_id
    )
    SELECT
        r.entity_key AS entity_key,
        'siem-stream-corr' AS source,
        r.ts_first AS ts_first,
        r.ts_last AS ts_last,
        r.recent_alerts AS hits,
        concat('{"event_type":"assignment_batch_rule","source_id":"CORR-S-001","rule_id":"', r.entity_key, '","recent_alerts":', toString(r.recent_alerts), ',"baseline_5m":', toString(b.baseline_5m), '}') AS context_json
    FROM recent r INNER JOIN baseline b ON r.entity_key = b.entity_key

) AS candidate
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT entity_key
    FROM siem.alerts_raw
    WHERE rule_id = 8211
      AND ts >= now() - INTERVAL 86400 SECOND
      AND lower(status) NOT IN ('closed', 'false_positive', 'resolved', 'suppressed')

) AS existing

        'navidrome-01' AS source,
        min(ts) AS ts_first,
        max(ts) AS ts_last,
        count() AS hits,

            '{"event_type":"navidrome_mass_transfer","source_id":"NAV-004",',

            toString(count()),
            ',"bytes":',
            toString(transferred_bytes),

    WHERE lowerUTF8(host_name) = 'navidrome-01'
      AND device_product IN ('linux.navidrome', 'linux.nginx', 'linux.oauth2-proxy')
      AND
      (
          subcategory IN ('navidrome_stream', 'navidrome_download', 'media_stream', 'media_download')
          OR event_action IN ('playback', 'media_stream', 'media_download')
          OR positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(message), 'stream started') > 0

      AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'benchmark') = 0
      AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'synthetic') = 0
      AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'e2e') = 0
    GROUP BY entity_key
    HAVING transferred_bytes >= 1073741824 OR hits >= 100

(

batch_rules.title: MET-001 CPU > 90% 10m
batch_rules.operator_action: Создать alert, приложить host, user/src_ip, service/container, raw event, счетчики окна.
batch_rules.description: MET-001: cpu_usage>90 for 10m Источники: Proxmox/qemu-guest-agent/exporter/SIEM metrics.
batch_rules.sql_template:
INSERT INTO siem.alerts_raw
(ts, alert_id, rule_id, rule_name, severity, ts_first, ts_last, window_s, entity_key, hits, context_json, source, status)
SELECT
    now(),
    generateUUIDv4(),
    8418,
    'CPU > 90% 10m',
    'medium',
    candidate.ts_first,
    candidate.ts_last,
    {WINDOW_S},
    candidate.entity_key,
    candidate.hits,
    candidate.context_json,
    candidate.source,
    'open'
FROM
(
    SELECT
        if(host_name != '' AND host_name != '-', host_name, log_source) AS entity_key,
        if(host_name != '' AND host_name != '-', host_name, log_source) AS source,
        minIf(ts, cpu_pct > 90) AS ts_first,
        maxIf(ts, cpu_pct > 90) AS ts_last,
        countIf(cpu_pct > 90) AS hits,
        concat(
            '{"event_type":"sustained_cpu_pressure","source_id":"MET-001","source":"',
            if(host_name != '' AND host_name != '-', host_name, log_source),
            '","high_samples":', toString(countIf(cpu_pct > 90)),
            ',"samples":', toString(count()),
            ',"average_cpu_pct":', toString(round(avg(cpu_pct), 1)), '}'
        ) AS context_json
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            ts,
            host_name,
            log_source,
            toFloat64OrZero(
                extract(toString(normalized_json), '"cpu_pct":([0-9.]+)')
            ) AS cpu_pct
        FROM siem.events
        PREWHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL {WINDOW_S} SECOND
        WHERE device_product = 'host.metrics'
          AND subcategory = 'host_runtime_snapshot'
          AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(normalized_json), '"cpu_pct"') > 0
          
          AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(normalized_json), '"cpu_scope":"') > 0
          AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'allowlist:') = 0
          AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'benchmark') = 0
          AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'synthetic') = 0
          AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'e2e') = 0
    )
    GROUP BY entity_key, source
    HAVING count() >= 10
       AND hits >= 8

batch_rules.sql_template:
INSERT INTO siem.alerts_raw
(ts, alert_id, rule_id, rule_name, severity, ts_first, ts_last, window_s, entity_key, hits, context_json, source, status)

    8429,

    'high',
    candidate.ts_first,
    candidate.ts_last,
    {WINDOW_S},
    candidate.entity_key,
    candidate.hits,
    candidate.context_json,
    candidate.source,
    'open'
FROM
(
    SELECT
        concat(host_key, '|', service_name) AS entity_key,
        host_key AS source,
        min(ts) AS ts_first,
        max(ts) AS ts_last,
        count() AS hits,
        concat(
            '{"event_type":"service_restart_loop","source_id":"MET-012","source":"',
            host_key, '","service":"', service_name,
            '","restart_events":', toString(count()), '}'
        ) AS context_json
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            ts,
            if(host_name != '' AND host_name != '-', host_name, log_source) AS host_key,
            if(
                extract(toString(normalized_json), '"service":"([^"]+)"') != '',
                extract(toString(normalized_json), '"service":"([^"]+)"'),
                if(
                    extract(toString(message), '([A-Za-z0-9_.@-]+\.service)') != '',
                    extract(toString(message), '([A-Za-z0-9_.@-]+\.service)'),
                    'unknown-service'
                )
            ) AS service_name,
            subcategory
        FROM siem.events
        PREWHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL {WINDOW_S} SECOND
        WHERE
          (
              subcategory = 'host_service_flapping'
              OR
              (
                  subcategory = 'linux_systemd_restart_scheduled'
                  AND event_action = 'service_restart'
              )
          )
          AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(message), 'container-getty@') = 0
          AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(message), 'getty@') = 0
          AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(message), 'apt.systemd.daily') = 0

          AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'allowlist:') = 0

          AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'synthetic') = 0
          AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'e2e') = 0
    )
    GROUP BY host_key, service_name
    HAVING countIf(subcategory = 'host_service_flapping') >= 3
        OR countIf(subcategory = 'linux_systemd_restart_scheduled') >= 5
) AS candidate
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT entity_key
    FROM siem.alerts_raw

            '","hits":', toString(count()), '}'
        ) AS context_json
    FROM siem.events
    WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL {WINDOW_S} SECOND
      AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'allowlist:') = 0
      AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'benchmark') = 0
      AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'synthetic') = 0
      AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(tags), 'e2e') = 0
      AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(lowerUTF8(if(host_name != '' AND host_name != '-', host_name, log_source)), 'e2e') = 0
      AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(lowerUTF8(if(host_name != '' AND host_name != '-', host_name, log_source)), 'assignment-full') = 0

      AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(lowerUTF8(if(host_name != '' AND host_name != '-', host_name, log_source)), 'eps-bench') = 0
      AND if(host_name != '' AND host_name != '-', host_name, log_source) != ''
      AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(message), 'host runtime snapshot') = 0
      AND (positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(message), 'rsyslog') > 0 OR positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(message), 'SYSLOG/SVC') > 0)
      AND (positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(message), 'stopped') > 0 OR positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(message), 'failed') > 0)
      AND (positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(message), 'heartbeat') > 0 OR positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(toString(message), 'dependent senders') > 0)
    GROUP BY entity_key
